data.exact_reserve_text: An adverse run off deviation of GBP 1.5m (2017: favourable run off deviation of GBP 0.8m) was experienced during the year, wholly in respect of reserve movements on the 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015 year of account Whole Account Quota Share contracts with Syndicate 2003 and the Legacy Catlin Group entities.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced an adverse run-off deviation of GBP 1.5m in 2018, indicating a strengthening of prior year reserves. This movement was wholly attributed to reserve adjustments on the 2012, 2013, 2014, and 2015 underwriting years for Whole Account Quota Share contracts, primarily affecting Treaty and Reinsurance - Casualty/Property lines of business.

data.data_quality_notes: The gross claims development triangle on page 14 shows a different prior year development figure than the explicit statement in Note 6. This discrepancy is likely due to the closure of the 2016 year of account by Reinsurance to Close (RITC) at the end of 2018, which distorts the claims development triangle for older years. The explicit statement in Note 6 is prioritized for the prior year development figure.
